about: Card text and thumbnails for the .rfm1 files of Quixotic7/RemoteFM1FW, by manifest id (catalog/SCHEMA.md).

amb.what: A generative ambient machine after Music for Airports: it plays itself from the start, breathing voices, bells on tape loops of unequal length, a gliding bass. You do not perform it, you tend it.
amb.author: C. Vestal

arcticscream.author: PolarPatch
arcticscream.what: Arctic Scream is a dark-ambient drone machine built on GR!MM: four tracks over FM, supersaw, formant, tonewheel, physical-model, phase-distortion and sample sources, plus Holvut, a feedback string-and-body loop that wakes, howls and overblows into screams. Drones wander and build like a storm; WARP and MORPH twist the sound, with a huge SPACE reverb and freeze, GRAIN, TAPE and a HORROR scale.

aurora.author: twochannels
aurora.what: Epic film sounds: an eight-voice spectral pad of sine partials that drifts on its own, a swarm of saws, shaped wind, a shimmer plate, a tape delay and a freeze that holds a cloud of grains. Every page is a picture the four knobs shift, and HOME is an aurora bent by the sound.

berlinan.author: Jiří Píša
berlinan.what: A generative Berlin School MIDI sequencer: a small ensemble of voices that repeat, phase against each other on loops of unequal length and earn their mutations over time. The FM-1 makes no sound with it: each voice goes out over USB on its own MIDI channel to your synths, as Berlinan for macOS…

bytemania.author: lloyd
bytemania.what: A bytebeat synth: play one-line formulas, tweak them with the knobs, and write your own, with a random button in the formula creator that is really fun. A beta, built on Dinghy.

caravel.what: Multi-engine synth firmware with DRONE, STASIS texture capture, Pair Morph, and per-track Random Morph and Morph Journey for evolving, ambient and experimental sound design. Sequencer, MIDI Learn, USB audio.
caravel.author: BonszaiMusic

carnacos.author: Owen Kirby
carnacos.what: CARNAC OS is a dual-timbral wavetable synth inspired by neolithic monuments and forgotten rituals. Built for deep sound design and immediate control, with a MAQ 16/3-style sequencer and a J6-style chord arp. The PCM waves need a separate installer: get it from my GitHub page.

fields.what: CARNAC OS is a dual-timbral wavetable synth inspired by neolithic monuments and forgotten rituals. Built for deep sound design and immediate control, with a MAQ 16/3-style sequencer and a J6-style chord arp. The PCM waves need a separate installer: get it from my GitHub page.

chipbox.author: pbarilla
chipbox.what: A ultra-refined Chiptune music editor, featuring over 35 classic chips such as NES, Gameboy, heck even the Sunsoft 5B! Gimmick fans rejoice!

choralroot.what: A Telepathic Orchid-style chord instrument: one hand plays roots, the other shapes chords; voicings, performance modes, bass and a looper.
choralroot.author: Quixotic7

clipper.what: A deep synth grown out of SLOOP: 23 engines and 407 sounds, from HYBRID (three oscillators, two filters, a mod matrix) to six-operator FM, wavetables, wave sequencing, a Juno and physical models; arp, step sequencer, MPE and a web editor for every parameter.
clipper.author: isod89

coralflower.what: Chords after the Orchid, with controls made for the FM-1: one key plays a chord with a bass note. Also 27 scales, an arpeggiator, a sequencer with drums and a song mode, and a pixel flower that grows as you play.
coralflower.author: FicusFicusov

ctl1.author: Charles Vestal
ctl1.what: CTL-1 turns the FM-1 into a MIDI controller: keys with velocity and aftertouch in any scale with chords under the black keys, four knobs sending controllers in four banks, an arpeggiator and a four-track Euclidean drum sequencer on its clock. Everything goes out as MIDI, and the built-in General MIDI sounds play along, so it works with nothing connected.

drift.author: FBNFRTG
drift.what: An ambient instrument for live sessions: warm synths, spacious pads and delicate plucks over a generative Euclidean sequencer on one track, with delays and reverbs from spring to shimmer. Built on Felucca.

duell.what: A MULTIMORPHING bitimbral synth: two complete parts, three ways to play them together, and a morph that glides between two versions of every sound. Ten engines including wavetables, twin filters, effects and a mod matrix. Layer, dual or stereo mode. Velocity sensitivity and aftertouch. Dual core.
duell.author: OSCILL/R

dungeontracker.author: Bourbon Weather
dungeontracker.what: A four-track groovebox that is a dungeon crawler: your party plays the music, the rogue drums, the fighter bass, the cleric pads and the mage the melody. Step-program in a tracker or record live, and see how deep you get.

echofield.author: Philip Bos
echofield.what: A granular sampler: a few seconds of any sound become slow clouds, sparkles, tape loops and swells, played from the keys and knobs. Six modes (CLOUD, DUST, TAPE, BLOOM, PULSE, DRIFT), held performance effects, RANDOM with locks, RESAMPLE, 14 CC0 factory sounds and 16 slots for your own, with a companion web app for samples and presets.

elasticat.author: Quixotic7
elasticat.what: A norns-style loop mangler: six tracks of loops, slices and grains with a 128-step sequencer, parameter locks, hold menus and a 128-slot sample pool. Loads WAVs from your RemoteFM1 folder (audio/), saves projects and takes to data/. A Fantasy CFW: runs in RemoteFM1 only, never on an FM-1.

etch.author: Joppe Sikken
etch.what: Draw your own waveforms, morph between sounds, and bring them to life with modulation, evolving textures, and powerful effects. From warm analog-inspired tones to wild experimental soundscapes, ETCH puts sound design right at your fingertips.

fartmachine.author: A. C. Wilson
fartmachine.what: A questionable musical instrument: ten artisanal farts, reverb, delay and a sixteen-step sequencer.

felucca.what: The custom firmware the others build on: the FM-1's own synth engines, a sequencer, effects and a better panel, with an editor in the browser.
felucca.author: Hügelton

fimba.what: A physically modelled kalimba: tines laid out like the real one, thumb-roll chords, mbira patterns, a sound hole to cover, grains, tape and a plate reverb. Play it in the browser first.
fimba.author: J. Sowers

fizz.what: A groovebox around one engine, ChoralRoot's FM TONE: eight tracks, p-locks and preset sound locks, conditions, ratchets, chords, and MIDI FX for generative patterns and for reworking the ones you have. Bluetooth MIDI, and recording over USB audio.
fizz.author: Quixotic7

fields.what: A groovebox around one engine, ChoralRoot's FM TONE: eight tracks, p-locks and preset sound locks, conditions, ratchets, chords, and MIDI FX for generative patterns and for reworking the ones you have. Bluetooth MIDI, and recording over USB audio.
fields.author: Quixotic7

fmel1.author: AntonioAltea
fmel1.what: FMEL-1 turns the FM-1 into a Mellotron: every key plays its own length of real tape, recorded from Taijiguy's 1973 M400S: flute, choir, cello and vibes, plus a lo-fi piano. Layer a second sound and colour it with tape wow, flutter, hiss and wear, vibrato, echo, hall or plate reverb, a speaker EQ and a half-speed motor switch. ARP and a 16-step sequencer play along, and Javi's animated players act out each sound.

fmini.what: A three-oscillator monosynth in the spirit of the classic Moogs: a 24 dB/octave ladder filter, two contours, 100 factory patches, an arpeggiator, a sequencer and MIDI. Built on Felucca.
fmini.author: ruppert

fomni.what: A chord harp inspired by the Omnichord: strum the white keys, pick chords on the black ones.
fomni.author: C. Vestal

frasil.author: Styves Goupil
frasil.what: An ambient drone instrument: tap a key to latch a drone, a note or a chord in your key. Three layers a voice into a big reverb with shimmer and freeze; GLINT's icy FM bells on top, by hand, arpeggio or sequence; BASS a deep line below, held or sequenced; three LFOs keep it all moving.

ghoulbox.what: Dungeon synth: a cathedral hall reverb, tape and crush, a hurdy-gurdy engine, choirs, organs and recorded psaltery and harp, an old-RPG screen with wall torches.
ghoulbox.author: J. Persinger

golana.author: Gadlele
golana.what: One analog-style synth laid out like the classic microKORG, with a screen that draws the sound.

grimm.what: Dark ambient, dungeon synth and deathdream firmware: 4 tracks, 7 sound sources, real recorded choirs, tracks that play by themselves, and long tape, granular and reverb effects.
grimm.author: GRiMMBIENT

guitchordi.author: Stoogs
guitchordi.what: A chord and string instrument: 16 synthesized sounds, 50 chord styles, editable voicings, guitar tunings, and Freeplay, Strum and Arp modes with partial-chord pulses.

hawkchua.author: plieuwski
hawkchua.what: Noise and modeling synth with GM-style presets (4 banks, 512) and a 4-track tape recorder: each voice a live Chua circuit or noise program, through vactrol gates into resonators and piano, drum, voice, flute, brass, bowed, reed and bird waveguides, with temple, cathedral and mosque reverbs. XG…

hortator.what: A drum machine: eight tracks of drums, a step sequencer, Grids, a pumping compressor, LFOs, resonators and live effects. Play it in the browser first.
hortator.author: DEADACTIVE

hyp1.author: RedtailWorks
hyp1.what: Hypnotic techno and acid: a breathing pad, a deep drone, a generative 303 line and grain over drums you sequence. Flip patterns on the bar, break it down, build it up. Forked from AMB-1. One of a pack of four: LOF-1 (a lofi groovebox), ECO-1 (a plant plays it) and GRAV-1 (a star and its planets), experimental, on its project page.

jiant.what: A bio-synthetic groovebox: six tracks drawn as living beings in thermal colours, eight engines (FM6 with Dexed, analog, phase, voice…), mutating macros, song mode from SLOOP. Not yet tested much on a real FM-1.
jiant.author: juanjiant

karma.what: A four-track groovebox: an acid bass or a Juno-style poly, physical modelling, two dozen synthesis models and a drum synth. A 64-step sequencer with song mode, generators that write parts on one chord plan, pixel characters, and USB audio with six stems, MIDI out and DAW sync.
karma.author: A. Muchnik

kwasub.author: Omnipotard
kwasub.tag: K-WA SUB is a powerful bass…
kwasub.what: K-WA SUB is a powerful bass synthesizer for the M-VAVE FM-1, featuring 9 synthesis engines with 2 engines playable simultaneously and morphing capabilities. A dedicated sample layer adds attack and texture, while 3 freely assignable MIDI-learnable LFOs, quantized live effects and extensive sound…

matryoshka.author: glvno
matryoshka.what: A modular synth you patch in the browser: modules (oscillators, filters, envelopes, delays) nest into assemblies you save and reuse, and the patch plays on the FM-1, polyphonic with a Voicing module.

melodee.what: Total playing pleasure, far beyond Felucca: recording without quantize, microtonal scales, a Casio CZ-1, a bit-by-bit Dexed, scale modes made for an MPC Sample as its companion.
melodee.author: keremimo

minitone.what: Felucca with six tracks and new engines: SID, Braids' 48 models, a TB-303 and engines after Elektron's Analog Four, SY Chip and Digitone 2, a ping-pong delay and a new reverb. Built on Felucca 1.5.
minitone.author: S. Schmitz

mnm1.author: Veff
mnm1.what: Six monophonic tracks of synth and FX machines, pages of eight knobs, a filter and a tape delay on every track, three LFOs a track, parameter locks and slides. Forked from Hortator, with sounds ported from MONO2K.

modelar.author: Hirakos
modelar.what: A semi-modular drone synth played like a Kaoss Pad: four oscillators modulating each other through eight routings, and keys that move a cursor on an XY pad instead of playing notes: white keys are points, black keys gestures. ARP, a polymetric sequencer, a clock in Hz and eight generative environments.

mono2k.author: Iñigo Hernandez
mono2k.what: Six mono machines in the spirit of Elektron's Monomachine: FM, superwaves, wavetables, a SID, a voice and four drum synths, one per track. A 64-step sequencer with parameter locks, trig conditions and ratchets, a lofi bus, four demo parts and a web patch editor.

mope1.author: slothpallas
mope1.what: A sad wavetable synth played by a pixel blob in a rainy room: its eyes are the filter, its mouth the envelope, its tears the delay. Toy-keyboard accompaniment with 13 gloomy beats, auto-bass, arpeggiator, loop recorder.

mutabledreams.author: Kid Bunka
mutabledreams.what: Six assignable synth tracks, or a Lo-Fi kit plus three synths. Explore 156 contrasting musical Biomes, 352 sounds and thirteen scales; shape generative rhythms, chord journeys and per-track MIDI; play and edit in your browser.

fields.what: Six assignable synth tracks, or a Lo-Fi kit plus three synths. Explore 156 contrasting musical Biomes, 352 sounds and thirteen scales; shape generative rhythms, chord journeys and per-track MIDI; play and edit in your browser.

niagaradrift.author: E. Yerburgh
niagaradrift.what: Two drones that breathe and drift on their own, after the Lyra-8, Subharmonicon and DS-2: twelve presets on the white keys, gestures and scenes to move them, an LFO, delay and a reverb that freezes. Press PLAY to fade them in.

nomansky.author: Hericdk
nomansky.what: No Man Sky FM is a space adventure you play while you make music, built on SLOOP 2.7.1: one hand flies the ship with two knobs while the other plays the soundtrack. Land on planets, mine, fight sentinels and pirates, race, escort ships and warp between stars, while every SLOOP screen (four-track sequencer, engines, arp, FX) floats over the game.

obervave.what: An 8-voice analog-style poly in the spirit of the classic American polys of 1979-84, now on four tracks: each its own sound, arp and sequence; a mixer with chorus, delay, plate reverb and drive sends, a master with DJ filter and compressor. Tracks start on the bar, patterns keep their sounds.
obervave.author: zvenson

penumbra.author: Lunar Eclipse Forge
penumbra.what: A cinematic space drone you travel through, not one that plays itself. Five drone voices hold a pedal; turn PRESET and they glide to the next scene one voice at a time, or MORPH there by hand. Play VOX over it in key, loop it and the loop follows the key, or hold a key to bend and throw the sound.

perf1.author: deamonSLINKY
perf1.what: A generative groovebox you perform on: ten genres of self-playing pieces, an auto-DJ with breakdowns, builds and drops, Euclidean drums, an acid line that answers itself, beat FX and DX7-style FM voices from your own .syx.

pigeon.what: An old-school hip-hop and house sampler after the SP-404 and the PO-33: two song samples and a 16-pad kit, up to 32 chops a song, a 64-step sequencer, patterns and a song arrangement. Built on Felucca.
pigeon.author: The Shrimp Blimp

purplemonkey.what: A first instrument for toddlers: random key bashing and knob turning are rewarded with dancing animated pets and little musical sequences. Press a key, any key.
purplemonkey.author: Quixotic7

rainbow.what: A music toy for little children: 63 cartoon friends, every key in tune, chords, strumming, songs to follow and an ear game, notes on a staff, a volume cap for small ears.
rainbow.author: J. Bartlett

ravel.author: De-Pattern
ravel.what: An eight-track groovebox for sound design: thirteen synth engines, struck percussion and 33 drum machines after the Machinedrum, on an influence grid where any track can trigger, excite or modulate any other.

remotefm1.author: Quixotic7
remotefm1.what: The firmware this site installs, running as itself. On its own (0.3) the FM-1 is a DX7 with Yamaha's ROM voices, a MIDI controller, a looper and an arp; when a computer connects it becomes that computer's panel.

ripple.author: Charles Vestal
ripple.what: Instruments written in Lua (droplets) playing sounds written in Faust or C (currents), inspired by norns. Built-in droplets to start; add your own as Lua scripts in your RemoteFM1 folder (code/ripple/droplets) and pick "reload folder". A Fantasy CFW: runs in RemoteFM1 only, never on an FM-1.

rupture.author: Joppe Sikken
rupture.what: A monophonic bass synth on Cycle Exchange Synthesis: two sub-oscillators, a ladder filter, Channel EQ, eight effects from MOSFET drive to octave fuzz, a step sequencer up to 128 steps and an arpeggiator.

s1vave.what: An 8-voice virtual analog tweak synth: authentic 4-pole resonant filter, dual sub-oscillator, ADSR envelopes, 64-step sequencer, and hands-on live performance controls.
s1vave.author: Andrew GG

sid.author: Joakim Eriksson
sid.what: C64 music on the FM-1: a 6510 runs each tune's own code and reSID plays it, PSID and RSID. A GoatTracker 2 editor on the FM-1 itself with ten GT2 example songs, a SID synth with a sequencer and effects, and any .sid sent from the browser plays at once.

fields.what: C64 music on the FM-1: a 6510 runs each tune's own code and reSID plays it, PSID and RSID. A GoatTracker 2 editor on the FM-1 itself with ten GT2 example songs, a SID synth with a sequencer and effects, and any .sid sent from the browser plays at once.

sid1.author: putchdev
sid1.what: The Commodore 64's SID chip, twice for six voices. Its web app edits patches and takes them straight from .sid game music files.

sidj.author: thomasj
sidj.what: Plays C64 SID music from HVSC on an emulated 6581 or 8580 and lets you remix every voice live: transpose, mute, solo, swap waveforms, bend envelopes and filter, add LFOs, ride the tempo. Out of the jack, as USB audio or over ASID to a real SID. MIDI clock from the tune, or the tune synced to yours.

sidou.author: Denis Sablić
sidou.tag: Turns the FM-1 into a C64…
sidou.what: Turns the FM-1 into a C64 SID machine: two SIDs measured against real 6581 and 8580 chips, a GoatTracker 2 tracker and step sequencer with slide and accent, .sid playback, LAB for layered sounds with step tables and free LFOs, SidStation patch import, and Live Link in a browser.

fields.what: Turns the FM-1 into a C64 SID machine: two SIDs measured against real 6581 and 8580 chips, a GoatTracker 2 tracker and step sequencer with slide and accent, .sid playback, LAB for layered sounds with step tables and free LFOs, SidStation patch import, and Live Link in a browser.

skiff.what: Six tracks of synths and drums with a groovebox's workflow: fourteen engines, a 64-step sequencer with chords, ratchets, trig conditions and locks, songs, PERFORM with scenes, six themes and a browser editor; FM6 sounds built from scratch on the unit. Built on Felucca, with most of Felucca 1.6.1's work brought over (the second core, MIDI LEARN, INSERT); Felucca's sounds and projects load. Also runs on the SMK-37 Pro. Coming from 1.x: 2.0 saves in new formats – update on Skiff's own page (it backs up and converts), or back up in its editor first.
skiff.author: illuminus5

sloop.what: A live groovebox: tracks, layers, a step sequencer, song mode, punch-in effects and samples, played on the FM-1 in real time.
sloop.author: isod89

smileyface.author: pbarilla
smileyface.what: You're making acid, baby! Smash that LFO button until you hear something you like, and then twist those knobs! Now with 100% more FX! A truly trippy experience! Built on Chipbox.

speak37.what: The talking synth, its FM-1 build: every key speaks the next word of a sentence at its pitch and chords speak in harmony; nine voices, 20 banks of sentences and songs, RHYTHM with an 808.
speak37.author: M. Geisler

spellbox.author: Philippe Jaccoud
spellbox.what: SPELLBOX turns the FM-1 into a talking spelling toy after the 1978 Speak & Spell: an 8-character fluorescent display, a 10-pole LPC voice at 8 kHz through an 8-bit DAC, and the SPELL, LETTER, SAY IT, SECRET CODE and MYSTERY WORD games over four levels, with the keys as an A-to-Z keyboard. SPEAK…

tessera.author: Theo Dainis
tessera.what: Makes the FM-1 a small generative modular system. Rather than just generating notes, its thirteen generators create musical relationships: tracks follow, answer and share one harmony, and song forms develop over time. An instrument first, with one musical idea behind it.

tonitor.what: Six tracks for live ambient and experimental music: three synth engines, patches generated by algorithm, free-length loops with up to ten overdubs each, a granulator, filters and a lush reverb.
tonitor.author: N. Zimas

trax.author: jartificer
trax.what: A Mega Drive / Genesis music tracker. It emulates the YM2612 and SN76489 chips: six FM channels, three square waves and noise, with Deflemask-style effects, 128 FM presets, a drum kit on the DAC, 256 song slots, a demo song and VGM export.

fields.what: A Mega Drive / Genesis music tracker. It emulates the YM2612 and SN76489 chips: six FM channels, three square waves and noise, with Deflemask-style effects, 128 FM presets, a drum kit on the DAC, 256 song slots, a demo song and VGM export.

vector37.author: genkigenki
vector37.what: An orbiting overtone synth: four corners of two overtone generators each, a sun on a path and a moon around it decide how much of each you hear; the knobs shape the selected planet. Made for the SMK-37, here its FM-1 build. After the Beetlecrab Vector.

vesper.author: Fat Cat Studios
vesper.what: An ambient worship synth. Each scene layers four lush voices in any major key around a crystal orbit home screen: pads, plucks, piano and swells. Shape them with drive, tone, granular clouds, shimmer, reverb and delay, then play live over the scene or record into it.

x0x.what: A groovebox: 909 and 808 drums, two 303s with TB-3PO, a breakbeat generator and song mode.
x0x.author: C. Vestal

zen1.author: aceyprime
zen1.what: Ambient as a living window: cherry petals on a river, koi in a pond, fireflies under a real moon, and every movement a note. Set it down and let it play; the keys play along, the knobs shape the scene.
